en.headline: New businesses in {region} that still need a website
en.subheadline: Every week {firma} gets companies registered around {ort} in recent weeks – often before they have a website, branding or online presence. Where we could not find a website, the lead says so.

signals.title: Registered in the last weeks
signals.text: New owners pick their web designer early. Being first with a relevant offer matters more than being cheapest.

signals.title: No website found yet
signals.text: We check each new company for an existing site and note it when none is found – your warmest leads.

signals.title: Checked and sourced
signals.text: Each lead shows the company, date, address and the official register entry.

faq.a: Only companies in the areas you choose – for example {region} – with a fresh, dated event that gives you a reason to get in touch. Each lead is delivered to you once.

faq.q: Where does the data come from?
faq.a: Official company registers, official announcements and companies' own careers pages. We do not use LinkedIn, job boards or other platforms whose terms forbid it.

faq.q: Is there personal data in the leads?
faq.a: No. Company data only: name, address, website, main phone number where published, the event and its source.

faq.q: How does this fit a web agency?
faq.a: New companies need a site, a logo and a way to be found. The weekly list gives {firma} those companies in {region} while the decision is still open.

faq.q: What does the free sample include?
faq.a: 10 current leads from {region}, with the same fields as the weekly delivery. No obligation, no card required.

fr.headline: Les nouvelles entreprises de {region} qui n'ont pas encore de site
fr.subheadline: Chaque semaine, {firma} reçoit les sociétés créées récemment autour de {ort}, souvent avant qu'elles aient un site ou une identité visuelle.

signals.title: Créations récentes
signals.text: Les nouveaux dirigeants choisissent leur prestataire web dans les premières semaines.

signals.title: Source officielle
signals.text: Chaque piste indique la société, la date, l'adresse et l'annonce BODACC.

faq.a: Uniquement des entreprises de vos zones – par exemple {region} – avec un événement récent et daté qui justifie une prise de contact. Chaque piste ne vous est livrée qu'une fois.
Registres officiels, annonces légales (BODACC) et pages carrières des entreprises. Ni LinkedIn ni sites d'emploi.
Non. Uniquement des données d'entreprise : nom, adresse, site, standard si publié, l'événement et sa source.
10 pistes actuelles de {region}, avec les mêmes champs que la livraison hebdomadaire. Sans engagement.
